about:
Ryobi Die Casting (USA), Inc. operates a manufacturing campus in Shelbyville, Indiana, as the North American arm of Japan-based Ryobi Limited. The facility serves as the company's primary U.S. production site.

The company specializes in the development and manufacture of complex aluminum die castings for structural automotive applications. Its in-house capabilities span research and development, die design, product design support, and process engineering. The Shelbyville campus employs more than 700 people and supports high-volume production of technically demanding castings.

Ryobi's customer base is the global automotive industry. The company has been recognized by Honda with a 2022 Excellence in Delivery and Quality award and by General Motors as a Supplier of the Year honoree, indicating long-standing relationships with major OEMs.

Ryobi states its mission is to win the superior confidence of the die casting market through responsibility, quality communication, and service to internal and external customers. Its values emphasize communication, change, challenge, and commitment, reflecting a culture focused on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.

old_description: The company was founded in 1985 and our Quality Management System has been certified to both
about:
RDS Wire & Cable, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Gardena, California. The company began as a supplier of wire, cable, and insulation solutions and has remained at the same location on East Gardena Boulevard.

The firm operates as a stocking distributor of electronic and electrical wire, cable, tubing, and sleeving. Its product range spans commercial UL AWM styles, military-specification wires such as MIL-W-16878 and SAE AS22759, coaxial cables, and a variety of heat-shrinkable and PTFE tubings. In addition to stocking, RDS provides value-added processing including etching of fluoropolymer (Teflon) wire and tubing, hot marking of heat-shrink tubing, cutting, stripping, striping, tinning, printing, and high-speed twisting of wire into custom cable assemblies.

Primary customers are in the military, aerospace, and commercial equipment manufacturing sectors. The company supplies materials meeting specifications such as MIL-C-27500, MIL-C-17, MIL-I-22129, and various SAE AS23053 heat-shrink standards, as well as UL-listed appliance wiring materials for industrial equipment builders.

RDS emphasizes low minimum-order quantities and fast order fulfillment, supported by an experienced sales staff and extensive processing and packaging capabilities. Its quality management system has been certified to ISO 9001 and AS9100 since 2003, and the company maintains RoHS, REACH, and conflict-minerals compliance.

name: REM Electronics
old_description: REM specializes in sourcing and replacing obsolete or hard-to-find components, helping customers avoid costly downtime and keep production on track. With our expertise and commitment to continuity, REM is a trusted partner in maintaining efficient, uninterrupted operations.
about:
REM Electronics Supply Company, Inc. operates from Warren, Ohio. The business was started in 1955 by Robert E. Miller (known as REM) as a sales and service operation focused on the consumer market with TV antennas and hi-fi equipment.

Today the company functions as a full-service distributor and value-added manufacturer with 30,000 to 75,000 square feet of office and warehouse space. Its manufacturing capabilities span SMT and through-hole assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, box build, 3D printing and prototyping, R&D and design assistance, component preparation and modification, X-ray inspection, and RFID services. The firm also provides full contract manufacturing, testing, and distribution.

REM serves U.S. government agencies involved in defense and national security, as well as manufacturers, assemblers, and repair teams across the electronics sector. The company emphasizes a local presence in Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania while supporting customers nationally.

The company highlights its specialization in sourcing obsolete and hard-to-find components to prevent production downtime, and it promotes U.S.-based manufacturing for tighter quality control, faster turnaround, and supply chain security. With 70 years in business and a manufacturing team holding over 250 years of combined experience, REM positions itself as a continuity partner for electronic component supply.

name: REV - Home Internet, TV, & Security
old_description: Since 1935, REV has been committed to not only being the best telecommunications provider but also to the growth and prosperity of South Louisiana. Through our involvement in and support of education, the arts, civic groups and non-profit organizations throughout South Louisiana, REV has always demonstrated its dedication to actively shaping and strengthening this special place we call home.
about:
REV is headquartered in Reserve, Louisiana, and traces its roots to 1935 when it began as a local telecommunications provider serving South Louisiana. The company operates as a private-owned entity and was restructured in 2020 as the combined parent of RTC, EATEL, EATEL Business, and Vision Communications, rebranding to REV in 2022. No individual founders are named in the available materials.

The company delivers fiber-optic internet, television, phone, and home security services to residential and business customers across its footprint. Its network spans more than 2,790 miles of fiber, supported by nearly 400 employees who serve over 60,000 customers. REV also operates VENYU, a cloud hosting, data center, and data protection provider with facilities in Louisiana and partner locations nationwide. Services include symmetrical gigabit internet with no data caps, whole-home WiFi using eero hardware, and managed modem provisioning.

REV serves communities from Baton Rouge to Grand Isle, covering the Bayou Region (Lafourche, Terrebonne, Grand Isle), River Region (St. James, St. John the Baptist), Capital Region (Ascension, East Baton Rouge, Iberville, Livingston), and the Shreveport/Bossier area. Its customer base includes households, businesses, and local non-profits such as Alzheimer's Services of the Capital Area and Volunteer Ascension, which have received grants through the company's employee-guided REVolutionizing Communities program.

REV emphasizes its local presence and community investment as key differentiators. It highlights no-contract, no-cap internet plans, symmetrical upload and download speeds, and customer service staffed by local representatives. The company also points to its employee-driven philanthropic voting process and the integration of VENYU's coast-to-coast data center network as factors that set it apart from national providers.

name: REYcomp INC
old_description: We are your competent partner for electronic assemblies that range from surface mount (SMT) and through-hole (TH) as well as wire harnesses all the way to complete product box build services and panel assembly.
about:
REYcomp INC, based in Grand Prairie, Texas, was founded in 2001. The company is led by CEO Georg Rey.

The company provides electronic assembly services including surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole (TH) PCB assembly, wire harness fabrication, box build, and panel assembly. It also offers PCB repair, parts procurement, first-article inspection (FAI), and country-of-origin (COO) management. Production uses Siemens SMT machines capable of placing components from QFB and BGA down to µBGA, CBDA, CSP, and flip-chip packages. REYcomp employs cellular manufacturing, single-piece flow, standardized work, and pull systems to reduce lead times and inventory.

The company serves customers requiring electronic assembly and repair services across various industries, though specific verticals are not disclosed in its public materials.

REYcomp emphasizes personalized customer support and quick-turn capabilities, with CEO Georg Rey noting that engineering changes are addressed directly without bureaucratic delays. The firm focuses on building one-on-one partnerships to deliver products on schedule at a competitive cost-performance ratio.

RFL serves the roofing and building-materials sectors, primarily supplying distributors that support residential and commercial roofing projects in the Phoenix metro area and the wider Southwest market.

The company highlights quick turnaround and competitive pricing for local customers, and positions its vent system as a market-moving innovation that delivers a smarter way to vent tile roofs.
